projects.title: MVVM OAuth2 Android App
bullets: Built an Android app with MVVM architecture using Dagger2, RxJava and Retrofit, adding OAuth2 authentication with ViewBinding.
Organized the implementation across 126 files to separate networking, view and data layers.

projects.title: MP4 Downloader
bullets: Built a second Android app in Kotlin, integrating Firebase Crashlytics and Google Play services into the build.
Structured the project across 131 files while wiring Dagger for dependency management.

leadership.title: Architecture Reviewer
bullets: Compared MVVM patterns across personal Android apps and wrote short notes so club peers could reuse them.
After peers spent more time debating architecture than shipping, began facilitating short scoping talks before each build.
Found guiding these discussions more engaging than implementing every screen, a signal behind pursuing a mobile product direction.
